_comment: Placements read off the image by hand, which tools/addrmap.py takes over any pass: name -> [1.11 address, why]. Each was checked against the bytes.
load_animation: called by game_intro at 0x0f679; 1.11's body clears the level flag and reads the level
save_machine: after load_animation as in 1.00; saves and restores 0x4cdb around write_level
is_machine_file: after save_machine as in 1.00; opens the file and checks the 0xaced/0xacee magic
get_puzzle_title: between count_level_files and password_to_level, as in 1.00
password_to_level: the resemblance pass gave it to is_machine_file
dos_find_name: mov ax, 0x28ec / retf, after the drive-letter getter as in 1.00
dos_find_size: the DX:AX pair from 0x2919/0x291b, straight after dos_find_name
vm_call_4_thunk: ljmp [0x3f52], the first of 1.11's four driver thunks
restore_write_mode: cmp byte [0x34b1], 0x10 after the four thunks, as in 1.00
conveyor_nudge_10: the first of the three nudges, before 0x1bb65 and 0x1bbb8
load_level: builds l<N>.lev (or another prefix for level 17) and calls read_level at 0x13a82 - the pattern pass took the look-alike save_level at 0x14144
save_level: builds l<N>.lev and calls write_level at 0x13f83
tab_move_pointer: after 1.11's two new region handlers at 0x127a1 and 0x127c8, before paint_game_screen as in 1.00
